headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped two-week winning streak as surging crude oil prices dragged markets lower.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Surging crude oil prices reaching $117 per barrel weighed on investor sentiment
Profit booking after the market recorded a two-week winning streak
Concerns over rising global energy costs and their impact on Indian shares
Weekly losses triggered by a three-day fall earlier in the week
whatHappening: Nifty finished the last trading session at the 22,600 level
Sensex ended lower by 125 points on Friday after a volatile session
IT stocks witnessed buying interest which helped the market rebound from intraday lows
IRDAI extended the feedback deadline for insurance distribution reforms to October 31
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices snapped a two-week winning streak, with the Nifty closing at 22,600. Surging crude oil prices, which hit $117 per barrel, weighed heavily on sentiment, leading to a 2% weekly decline for major benchmarks. While IT stocks provided some support, Adani Enterprises emerged as a top loser in the weekly wrap as investors remain cautious heading into next week.
